# Kora Demo

> Kora Demo offers a wide range of classic Thai dishes, including various curries, noodle dishes like Pad Thai, stir-fries, rice plates, soups, and appetizers. They use the finest ingredients and premium spices brought from Thailand, prepared with care for every guest.
